# DepositPhotos

> > DepositPhotos is a comprehensive royalty-free digital asset marketplace offering stock photos, videos, music, and AI-powered image generation tools for creators and enterprises.

DepositPhotos provides access to 330M+ licensed assets including HD/4K stock videos, editorial photography, royalty-free music, and an AI image generator. The platform serves individual creators and enterprises through flexible subscription plans and an API suite for programmatic access.

## Key Topics

- Stock Photos
- Royalty-Free Licensing
- Stock Videos
- HD/4K Footage
- AI Image Generator
- Generative AI
- Royalty-Free Music
- Sound Effects
- Stock Library
- API Suite
- Graphic Editor
- Editorial Photography
- Image Licensing
- Enterprise Solutions

## Core Collections & Asset Types

- [Stock Videos - HD/4K Royalty-Free](https://depositphotos.com/stock-videos.html): Stock videos in HD/4K with royalty-free licensing for commercial use
- [Royalty-Free Music & Sound Effects](https://depositphotos.com/music.html): Royalty-free music, audio, and sound effects library for multimedia
- [Editorial Photography](https://depositphotos.com/editorial-photography.html): Editorial stock photos and images for news and journalistic content
- [Background & Wallpaper Photos](https://depositphotos.com/photos/background.html): Stock photos of backgrounds with royalty-free licensing options
- [Business Stock Photos](https://depositphotos.com/photos/business.html): Business-related stock photos with royalty-free licensing
- [Event & Celebration Images](https://depositphotos.com/photos/celebration.html): Stock photos of celebrations, parties, and events for commercial use

## AI & Generative Tools

- [AI Image Generator](https://depositphotos.com/ai-image-generator.html): AI-powered text-to-image generator for creating unique licensed images
- [API Suite - Graphic Editor & Generative AI](https://depositphotos.com/api-suite.html): API suite with graphic editor, stock library, and generative AI tools for developers

## Pricing & Subscription

- [Subscription Plans & Pricing](https://depositphotos.com/subscribe.html): Subscription and pricing plans for stock photos, vectors, and videos
- [Enterprise Solutions](https://depositphotos.com/enterprise.html): Enterprise licensing plans with flexible payment and team collaboration
